kind: Isolated live experimental DFlash2 HTTP verification

scope.primary_service_scope: Existing process kept its running binary; this verification used a fresh isolated server.

sse_greedy.timing_scope: Elapsed interval recorded by the streaming helper; phase-event interval also includes surrounding bookkeeping.

stop_with_stream_open.scope_note: The original probe sent model/request_id in the JSON body, while the stop endpoint binds query parameters. This proves Stop for the selected worker with the stream open, not request-scoped routing.

assertion_evidence.stream_contract: The probe requires [DONE], requires the Generation stopped error for Stop, and checks worker readiness before leaving the open response context.

limits: One pinned Qwen3.5-2B pair at context512 and one short prompt; not model-maximum context or representative quality qualification.
Compilation/capture and request-order effects are included; HTTP timings are diagnostics, not a formal ordinary-versus-speculative benchmark.
No published RKLLM speed win or comparable-quality certification is established by this API check.
Sampled requests use ordinary fallback; trained sampled speculation is not implemented.
The mode remains opt-in/default-off, with no automatic measured API cost router.
Original Stop request identifiers were sent in JSON rather than query parameters, so request scope was not tested; selected-worker Stop while open and recovery passed.
source_hashes_scope: Historical HTTP-test cohort captured by the raw report. These hashes were checked when the initial compact record was written; evolving current source is not implied to match.
